verdict.rationale: SES documents publishing sending events to other AWS services (SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Firehose, Pinpoint) and routing inbound mail to SNS or Lambda. None of the evidence shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that SES itself delivers to a user endpoint. Any HTTP delivery would rely on a host-platform service (SNS or EventBridge) or a user-built Lambda forwarder, as one community user describes; neither earns credit, so the verdict stays at none.
